title: e-EPIC — Digital Voter ID Download
summary: e-EPIC is a free digital, downloadable, printable version of your Voter ID, legally equivalent to the physical card, available since 25 January 2021 on the official portal after OTP verification.
body:
If you already have an EPIC number and your registration is complete, you can download your e-EPIC directly from voters.eci.gov.in after logging in and verifying via OTP. This does not require applying through Form 8 — that form is only needed if you additionally want a physical replacement card mailed to you, or if you're correcting/updating details at the same time.

If you cannot find your EPIC number, use the roll search / 'search in electoral roll' tool on the same portal, or check with your BLO.
caution: Confirm the current e-EPIC download flow and OTP-verification steps on voters.eci.gov.in, as portal UX changes periodically.
